title: Enderman Face Mask
description: mingle with the Endermen without angry them, wear a facemask to trick them thinking you are one of them
body:
Make an Endermen Face Mask by renaming a carved pumpkin "Enderman Mask"! Great way to mingle with the Endermen in the end without them getting angry at you!
the pack will also remove the pumpkin texture infront of your eyes so you can see clearly!
